about: What each environment variable the Go code reads does, for docs/env-vars.md (refactor plan step D1). go run ./internal/tools/envdoc renders it with the names and constant defaults of internal/archtest/testdata/env_vars.txt (S8's inventory). Keys are variable names; area is an area of docs/areas.json; read_by names the program (server, agentd, openv-mcp); default is given only where the inventory has no single constant default, or its constant is the empty string that a later step replaces; text says what the variable does, in Markdown, without a bare pipe.

AGENTS_DIR.text: Directory of the file-backed agent definitions; the boot backfill also reads it.

AGENT_CHILD_CONCURRENCY.text: Extra run slots a runner keeps for child and interview runs, a whole number above 0; `-child-concurrency=0` on the command line reserves none.

AGENT_CONCURRENCY.text: How many normal runs a runner executes at once (`-concurrency`).

AGENT_WORKSPACE_RETENTION.text: How long a finished run's workspace is kept before cleanup, a positive Go duration (`-workspace-retention`).

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.text: When set in the runner's environment, Claude Code counts as signed in (API key mode) without an interactive sign-in. Passed on to the CLI exactly as set.

CLOUD_SHELL.text: One of the Gemini CLI's auth-mode variables: when it is set, a Gemini run is not switched to the runner's OAuth sign-in (`GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA`).

CODEX_HOME.text: Where the Codex CLI keeps its sign-in; the runner looks for `auth.json` there to tell whether Codex is signed in.

CONNECTOR_DIST_DIR.text: Directory holding the Agent Connector downloads that `/api/v1/public/connector/download` serves (`make connector-dist` writes them).

CORS_ORIGIN.text: The one browser origin the API answers with credentials (the frontend's). A wildcard or an empty value stops the server at start-up.

CROSS_SITE_COOKIES.text: `true` when the frontend and the API are on different sites: session cookies become `SameSite=None; Secure; Partitioned` (no Safari or iOS sign-in) and responses carry HSTS.

DATABASE_URL.text: A `postgres://` or `postgresql://` connection URL; when set it wins over the `DB_*` settings. A credential, used exactly as set; one that does not parse stops the server without printing it.

DB_PASSWORD.text: Database password, when `DATABASE_URL` is unset. A credential: reaches the database exactly as set.

FRONTEND_URL.default: `$PUBLIC_URL`, then `http://localhost:3000`, for links; `http://localhost:3000` for the sign-in redirects
FRONTEND_URL.text: Where the app is served: links in mail, share and open-source pages, Stripe's return pages, and where Google and OIDC sign-in land. The two fallback chains differ (contract quirk Q12).

GEMINI_API_KEY.text: When set in the runner's environment, the Gemini CLI and Antigravity count as signed in (API key mode), and a Gemini run keeps this auth mode rather than the runner's OAuth sign-in.

GEMINI_CLI_USE_COMPUTE_ADC.text: One of the Gemini CLI's auth-mode variables: when set, a Gemini run is not switched to the runner's OAuth sign-in.

GOOGLE_API_KEY.text: When set in the runner's environment, the Gemini CLI counts as signed in (API key mode), and a Gemini run keeps this auth mode.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.text: Turns on Sign in with Google; the callback is `$PUBLIC_URL/api/v1/auth/google/callback`.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.text: Google sign-in's client secret. A credential, used exactly as set.

GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL.text: One of the Gemini CLI's auth-mode variables: when set, a Gemini run is not switched to the runner's OAuth sign-in.

GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA.text: The Gemini CLI's OAuth auth mode. A run adds it itself unless this or another auth-mode variable is already set, in the run's own environment or the runner's.

GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI.text: One of the Gemini CLI's auth-mode variables: when set, a Gemini run is not switched to the runner's OAuth sign-in.

HOME.text: A pool node remembers its own `HOME` at start and points `HOME` at a fresh directory under `RUNNER_SESSION_ROOT` for each lease (`os.Setenv`), so a member's sign-ins never outlive the lease. The runner's default `-workspaces` (`~/.openv/workspaces`) and the provider probes also start from it.

HOSTED_RUNNERS.text: `off` turns hosted runners off. Otherwise they are on whenever the Docker daemon answers, and off, with a log line, when it does not.

HOSTED_RUNNER_PIDS_LIMIT.text: Task cap (threads, not processes) of each hosted runner container; `0` or less means no cap. Read again for each runner the API provisions.

OPENAI_API_KEY.text: When set in the runner's environment, the Codex CLI counts as signed in (API key mode). Passed on to the CLI exactly as set.

OPENV_API_TOKEN.text: A workspace runner key for `openv-mcp` when it is not started for a platform run (an agent maintaining a requirements project, a developer's CLI). `OPENV_RUN_TOKEN` wins where both are set. The runner keeps it from every process it starts.

OPENV_API_URL.text: The API base URL a runner (`-api`) and `openv-mcp` call, as seen from where they run.

OPENV_AUTH_ACCOUNT_BURST.text: Failed sign-ins one account may make at once before `429`.

OPENV_AUTH_ACCOUNT_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Failed sign-ins per account per hour, steady state.

OPENV_AUTH_IP_BURST.text: Sign-in attempts one client address may make at once; email verification and password reset spend the same bucket (contract quirk Q18).

OPENV_AUTH_IP_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Sign-in attempts per client address per hour, steady state.

OPENV_BILLING_GRANDFATHER_BEFORE.text: An RFC 3339 date-time that turns the plan tiers on: workspaces created before it keep the alpha terms, written into their limits once at boot. Ignored on a self-hosted deployment; a value that does not parse stops the server.

OPENV_BILLING_MAX_SEATS.text: The seat count above which a seat push to Stripe is refused. Anything but a whole number above 0 stops the server.

OPENV_BILLING_RECONCILE_MINUTES.text: How often subscriptions are re-read from Stripe, in whole minutes above 0; anything else stops the server.

OPENV_BILLING_REFRESH_BURST.text: Billing refreshes (a re-read of the workspace's subscription) one workspace may make at once.

OPENV_BILLING_REFRESH_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Billing refreshes per workspace per hour, steady state.

OPENV_BILLING_RETURN_URL.text: The app origin Stripe's checkout and portal pages send people back to, trailing slash trimmed.

OPENV_BILLING_TRIAL_DAYS.text: A first-time buyer's trial in whole days; `0` turns trials off, and anything that is not a whole number stops the server.

OPENV_BILLING_WRITE_BURST.text: Checkouts, plan changes and portal sessions one workspace may start at once.

OPENV_BILLING_WRITE_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Checkouts, plan changes and portal sessions per workspace per hour, steady state.

OPENV_BUDGET_ENFORCE.text: `true` refuses new run launches once a workspace has spent its monthly budget (warn-only otherwise); a failed budget lookup lets the launch through.

OPENV_BUILD_SHA.text: The commit `/health` reports, for platforms that do not set `RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA`; with neither, `/health` leaves the commit out.

OPENV_CLIENT_IP_HEADER.text: A header the proxy in front sets to the real client address (`CF-Connecting-IP`), which the rate limits then key on. Read on each request that needs it.

OPENV_DATA_DIR.text: The server's data directory; only `AGENTS_DIR`'s default is under it.

OPENV_DEPLOYMENT.text: `shared` or `dedicated`: a dedicated instance polls the release feed daily and warns its admins before its support window closes.

OPENV_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_TYPES.text: Comma-separated notification types that are also emailed, once SMTP is configured.

OPENV_EMAIL_VERIFICATION.text: `off` lets password accounts in without confirming their address even where the server can send mail.

OPENV_EMBEDDING_API_KEY.text: Turns on semantic-search embeddings: artifacts are embedded on create and update, and the reindex endpoint backfills a project. A credential, used exactly as set; a key of only spaces leaves embeddings off.

OPENV_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL.text: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible embeddings API.

OPENV_HOSTED.text: `true` runs `agentd` as a hosted runner (`-hosted`): token mode, with no CLI sign-in and no repository-access runs.

OPENV_INTERVIEW_IP_BURST.text: Interview intro page loads one client address may make at once on the public interview endpoints.

OPENV_INTERVIEW_IP_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Interview intro page loads per client address per hour, steady state.

OPENV_INTERVIEW_MSG_BURST.text: Messages one interview invite may send at once; each one starts a priority agent run.

OPENV_INTERVIEW_MSG_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Messages per interview invite per hour, steady state.

OPENV_INTERVIEW_STREAM_BURST.text: Interview event-stream connects one client address may make at once (a bucket of its own, since browsers reconnect often).

OPENV_INTERVIEW_STREAM_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Interview event-stream connects per client address per hour, steady state.

OPENV_INVITE_BURST.text: Workspace invitations one inviting account may send at once.

OPENV_INVITE_PREVIEW_BURST.text: Invite-link previews one client address may make at once; share-link lookups and accepts spend the same bucket (contract quirk Q18).

OPENV_INVITE_PREVIEW_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Invite-link previews per client address per hour, steady state.

OPENV_INVITE_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Workspace invitations per inviting account per hour, steady state.

OPENV_LIMITS.text: A JSON object of workspace limit values that overrides any limit across the deployment, such as `{"max_upload_mb": 1024}`. An unknown key or a value that is not a number stops the server.

OPENV_LOG_LEVEL.text: `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`; anything else keeps `info` and says so once.

OPENV_MAX_BODY_MB.text: Cap on any request body, in MB. File uploads are bounded by their own caps instead.

OPENV_MAX_EVIDENCE_MB.text: Cap on one uploaded evidence file, in MB. Read on each upload.

OPENV_MAX_UPLOAD_MB.text: Cap on one figure upload, in MB, overriding every workspace's plan limit. Read on each upload.

OPENV_MCP_TOOLS.text: Comma-separated MCP tools `openv-mcp` serves; set but empty serves none. The runner sets it for each run from the agent's allowed tools.

OPENV_METRICS_TOKEN.text: When set, `/metrics` requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; unset, it is open, so firewall it. A credential, used exactly as set.

OPENV_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.text: OIDC single sign-on's client secret. A credential, used exactly as set.

OPENV_OIDC_ISSUER.text: Turns on single sign-on with one OIDC identity provider, found by discovery at this issuer URL; unset, the OIDC endpoints answer that it is not configured.

OPENV_OIDC_NAME.text: The provider's name on the sign-in button.

OPENV_OIDC_REDIRECT_URL.text: The OIDC callback URL registered with the provider.

OPENV_OIDC_SCOPES.text: Space-separated scopes to ask the provider for.

OPENV_PASSWORD_RESET_BURST.text: Password reset mails one address may be sent at once.

OPENV_PASSWORD_RESET_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Password reset mails per address per hour, steady state.

OPENV_PLAN_DEFAULT.text: The plan new workspaces are created on: `single`, `business_lite`, `business`, `enterprise`, `self_host` or the legacy `free` and `team`. Any other name is ignored and leaves `single`, on a self-hosted deployment too.

OPENV_PUSH_ENDPOINT_HOSTS.default: none: the built-in push services only
OPENV_PUSH_ENDPOINT_HOSTS.text: Comma-separated extra hosts (`*.example.com` for subdomains) a web push subscription's endpoint may name, besides the built-in list. Read on each subscribe.

OPENV_PUSH_NOTIFICATION_TYPES.text: Comma-separated notification types that are also pushed to subscribed devices, once VAPID keys are set.

OPENV_REGISTER_IP_BURST.text: Registrations one client address may make at once.

OPENV_REGISTER_IP_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Registrations per client address per hour, steady state.

OPENV_REGISTRATION.text: `closed` lets new accounts in only through an invitation link issued to the address being registered, or single sign-on. Any other value keeps it open, with a warning.

OPENV_RELEASE_FEED_URL.text: The release feed a dedicated instance (`OPENV_DEPLOYMENT=dedicated`) polls.

OPENV_RUN_AUTO_RETRY.text: `false` turns off the automatic retry of a run that failed for a retryable reason (provider unavailable, timeout, worker error).

OPENV_RUN_MAX_ATTEMPTS.text: Attempts a run's retry chain may make, the first included; `1` turns retries off.

OPENV_RUN_TOKEN.text: The token minted for one agent run, which the runner hands `openv-mcp`; the tools then reach only what that run may.

OPENV_SELF_HOSTED.text: `true` for a deployment somebody runs themselves: new workspaces start on the `self_host` plan, with every limit unlimited, a refusal never says to upgrade, and the plan tiers stay off.

OPENV_SESSION_IDLE.text: How long a session may go unused, a Go duration; it can be shortened, never lengthened past the default.

OPENV_SESSION_MAX_AGE.text: A session's absolute lifetime from sign-in, a Go duration; it can be shortened, never lengthened past the default. The cookie's own expiry follows it.

OPENV_SHARED_PRODUCT_DAILY_LIMIT.text: Demo products one workspace may add to the community pool per day.

OPENV_SHARED_PRODUCT_POOL_LIMIT.text: The most products the community pool holds.

OPENV_SMTP_FROM.text: The From address of mail the server sends.

OPENV_SMTP_HOST.text: SMTP server. Setting it turns on email notifications, invitation and password reset mail, and sign-up email verification.

OPENV_SMTP_PASSWORD.text: SMTP password. A credential, used exactly as set.

OPENV_SMTP_USER.text: SMTP user for PLAIN authentication. A credential, used exactly as set.

OPENV_SSO_IP_BURST.text: Single sign-on starts and callbacks one client address may make at once.

OPENV_SSO_IP_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Single sign-on starts and callbacks per client address per hour, steady state.

OPENV_STRIPE_API_VERSION.text: Pins the `Stripe-Version` header of every Stripe request.

OPENV_STRIPE_PRICES.text: The price map: a JSON array of `{price, plan, interval}` naming which Stripe price sells which plan. A malformed map stops the server.

OPENV_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS.text: How many proxies sit in front of the API; the client address is then read from `X-Forwarded-For`, counting from the right. Read on each request that needs it.

OPENV_TRUST_PROXY.text: `true` trusts one proxy hop, as `OPENV_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=1` does (the older form).

OPENV_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.text: Web push's VAPID private key, which signs requests to the push services. A credential, used exactly as set.

OPENV_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.text: Web push's VAPID public key, handed to browsers. `go run ./cmd/openv-vapid` makes a key pair.

OPENV_VAPID_SUBJECT.text: The operator contact push services see, a `mailto:` or `https:` URI; anything else leaves web push off.

OPENV_VERIFY_RESEND_BURST.text: Verification mails (resend or change of address) one account may ask for at once.

OPENV_VERIFY_RESEND_REFILL_PER_HOUR.text: Verification mails per account per hour, steady state.

PORT.text: The port the API listens on.

PUBLIC_URL.text: Where browsers and runners reach the API: the base of the Google and OIDC callbacks, the URL a paired Agent Connector calls, and of share preview images. Behind the frontend's proxy, that is the frontend origin.

RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA.text: Set by Railway: the commit `/health` reports unless `OPENV_BUILD_SHA` overrides it.

RUNNER_API_URL.text: The API base URL as a hosted runner container sees it.

RUNNER_IMAGE.text: The image hosted runner containers are created from.

RUNNER_NETWORK.text: The Docker network hosted runner containers join; it must reach the API at `RUNNER_API_URL`.

RUNNER_NODE_NAME.text: A pool node's stable name across restarts (`-node-name`), so a restarted node reclaims its own row.

RUNNER_POOL.text: The pool a pool node joins (`-pool`).

RUNNER_POOL_KEY.text: The transient runner pool's shared key. On the API, setting it turns cloud runner leases on; on `agentd` (`-pool-key`), it runs the process as a pool node. A credential, used exactly as set, and kept from every process the runner starts.

RUNNER_SESSION_ROOT.text: Parent directory of a pool node's per-lease `HOME` directories (`-session-root`), wiped at start-up and after every lease.

SECURE_COOKIES.text: `true` marks the session cookie `Secure` and adds HSTS to every response: set it once the deployment is reached over HTTPS only.

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.text: Turns billing on with this Stripe secret key. A credential, used exactly as set; a key of only spaces leaves billing off.

UPLOADS_DIR.default: `./uploads` (the report renderer's own read has none: contract quirk Q12)
UPLOADS_DIR.text: Where attachment and figure files are stored; created at start-up.

WORKER_API_KEY.text: The legacy shared runner key. The API registers it as the workspace key `env-bootstrap` of the first account's personal workspace, and revoking that key stops it; `agentd` (`-worker-key`) signs in with it. A credential, used exactly as set, and kept from every process the runner starts.
